blocks.x: Achala Nexus in the field — deployment patterns by industry, with committed outcomes.
Rollouts follow the Achala Method on this platform's rails:

items: baseline metrics locked; data-readiness assessed against the platform's contracts.
pilot on a bounded scope with falsifiable criteria and the platform configured for your controls.
staged rollout with SLO instrumentation, replay evidence and operator enablement.
challenger models/policies, conformance monitoring, quarterly value reviews.

blocks.x: Operators describe the change as boring, in the best sense: the platform handles the recoverable failures by policy, pages humans only on user impact, and every intervention is logged into the evidence trail automatically.

Databricks Feature Store, Kafka/Flink, Redis, OPA, core-system adapters — integrated through versioned contracts. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are maintained like products: schema changes are tested against consumer suites before release, and one contract update propagates to every human or agent consumer.
